reason: The live probability adapter schema has no RaidType ai_will_do or success_factors adapter, and probability_inspect returns no_weighted_surfaces for both native raid files. These are source-coverage cases, not claimed MCP scenario results.
sharedScenarioDefaults: Unless a case explicitly overrides it, ROOT exists and has_capitulated=no, the world_end global flag is absent, and the actor is unlocked and passes bio_kruger_last_resort_authority_is_valid.

Unless a case explicitly overrides it, FROM exists, ROOT is at war with FROM, they are not in the same faction, and var:target_state passes is_weaponized_zombie_raid_target_state and is_controlled_by=FROM.

The callback form binds zombie_native_raid_actor to ROOT, zombie_native_raid_victim to FROM, and zombie_native_raid_target_state to var:target_state; the callback helper rechecks all three pointers and current war, faction, policy, target validity, and controller.
The CBRN policy values come from common/script_constants/cbrn_system_constants.txt: retaliation_authority=2, limited_battlefield_authority=3, and unrestricted_authorization=5.
A retaliation record is keyed to the actual FROM.id through cbrn_retaliation_[TARGET_ID]_expiry_day. This plan leaves the engine ID symbolic and does not guess a numeric country ID.
candidatePoolCompleteness: These six custom zombie RaidTypes are the bounded source scope. The complete engine-wide native raid AI selection pool and target enumeration were not exposed by MCP, so no normalized AI selection probability is claimed.

declaredConditions: No zombie unlock arm is met: has_tech zombie_disease_bomb_delivery_systems=false, has_country_flag weaponized_zombies_completed=false, is_special_project_completed sp:weaponize_the_zombies=false.
Use a non-Kruger-state actor so bio_kruger_last_resort_authority_is_valid passes through NOT brilliant_scientist_is_active_kruger_state; keep war and target otherwise valid to isolate missing unlock.
Unlock via is_special_project_completed sp:weaponize_the_zombies=true.
Actor exists, has_capitulated=no, world_end is absent, and Kruger authority passes.
cbrn_use_policy=5 (unrestricted_authorization), FROM exists, has_war_with FROM=true, target is not in the same faction, and var:target_state is valid and controlled by FROM.
cbrn_use_policy=2 (retaliation_only), with an exact FROM target and active war.
The helper derives cbrn_retaliation_target_id from FROM.id; cbrn_retaliation_[TARGET_ID]_expiry_day exists and global.num_days is less than or equal to its expiry day.
Actor unlock, Kruger authority, faction, target-state validity, and controller checks pass.
Use cbrn_use_policy=2, a valid war and target, but omit the dynamic cbrn_retaliation_[FROM.id]_expiry_day record.
Use cbrn_use_policy=2 and a target-specific expiry record whose expiry day is less than global.num_days.
Use cbrn_use_policy=3 (limited_battlefield_authority), no exact retaliation right, and otherwise valid enemy/target-state bindings.
This native zombie surface uses strategic-use permission, so battlefield-only policy does not satisfy cbrn_policy_allows_strategic_use_against_from.

scenarios.expectedGate: Friendly RaidTypes visible and target gate passes under unrestricted authorization
declaredConditions: Actor has weaponized_zombie_friendly_to_humans.
Target state is zombie-controlled, valid, controlled by FROM, and FROM is an active enemy; actor unlock and unrestricted policy pass.
Hostile RaidTypes are hidden by their existing NOT friendly flag gate.
Keep actor authorization and target-state validity otherwise true, but has_war_with FROM=false.
Keep actor authorization and war true, but make var:target_state not controlled by FROM.
The final callback must likewise reject a target state whose controller no longer equals event_target:zombie_native_raid_victim.
Actor is in the active Kruger state and the existing brilliant_scientist_kruger_raid_ai_is_active path is true, or all canonical last-resort authority requirements are true.
All non-Kruger actor, policy, war, target, and callback bindings are valid.
Actor is in the active Kruger state, brilliant_scientist_kruger_raid_ai_is_active=false, and brilliant_scientist_krg_canonical_biological_last_resort_is_authorized=false.
All other authorization and target conditions are valid to isolate the Kruger authority failure.

classification.raidAiWeights: score-only source expressions; selection/ranking probability unresolved because no native RaidType AI adapter or complete engine candidate pool is exposed
classification.successFactors: source-defined native chance formulas; final scenario probabilities unresolved because no native RaidType success_factors adapter is exposed
classification.scenarioHashes: none generated; no scenario was submitted to an unsupported or unrelated adapter
